svg.title: Average one-way trip to work: 40 metro areas
svg.desc: One bar per metro area, from Census ACS 2020–2024. The same numbers are in the table on the page.
svg.text: Bars sorted by the published estimate. Thin lines: the 90% margin of error; two overlapping intervals are not meaningfully different.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates 2020–2024, table DP03. Chart: Diogo Fitness,
https://diogofit.com/learn/commute-by-metro/ (free to reuse with a link back; the data are the agency's).
